# FilaScan 0.2.5

FilaScan 0.2.5 adds OTA installation controls to the on-device firmware page.

## Changes

- Install an available firmware update directly from the display.
- Require a separate confirmation before downloading, installing and restarting.
- Keep update progress and errors visible on the firmware page.

## Installation

Install this release from the protected FilaScan web interface. After updating
to 0.2.5, future releases can also be installed from the firmware page opened
by swiping upward from the bottom edge. The merged ESP32-S3 image remains
available for USB recovery.
